location: Specific location of the patient's complaint and if necessary give examples based on patient's condition
timing: A particular time of day or any specific situations when the symptoms tend to occur or worsen?
severity: Severity of the patient's illness on a scale of 1-10
exacerbating_factors: Exacerbating factors of the patient's illness
relieving_factors: Relieving factors of the patient's illness
associated_symptoms: Symptoms accompanying patient's main main with examples based on patient's condition
progression: Progression of the patient's illness .i.e. whether it is getting better, worse or staying the same
episodes: whether the patient has experienced similar symptoms in the past? If yes, how he managed it?
impact_on_daily_life: How the patient's illness is affecting his or her daily life
current_medications: Current medications, including dosage and frequency if it is a prescription drug
exposure: Exposure to any infectious agents, toxins or environmental factors that could be contributing to the patient's illness
psychological_factors: Any psychological factors that could be contributing to the patient's illness
expectations: The patient's expectations for the evaluation or treatment
additional_info: Any additional information that the patient may want to share.
